rubrics.justification: The response incorrectly states that no Gardner score was provided and fails to analyze the known 3AB morphology (expanded blastocyst with A ICM and B TE), omitting key available morphological details.

It integrates most relevant patient factors well, including age, ovarian reserve, tubal factor, sperm quality, BMI, endometrium, and prior cycle history, though linkage to the actual 3AB embryo quality is limited.

The reasoning is generally structured and internally consistent, but it is weakened by the major premise error that morphology was unavailable and by probability estimates built on hypothetical embryo grades instead of the provided 3AB.

Much of the advice is broadly IVF-consistent, but recommending ERA early after a single failed cycle and suggesting immunologic/NK testing are not strongly guideline-supported; omission of direct interpretation of the provided Gardner grade also reduces alignment.

The response gives practical next steps for transfer support and contingency planning, but some recommendations are not ideally prioritized for this favorable young patient after only one prior failed cycle.
